note: The thin white lines painted into the menus' band art (the CURRENT MUSIC band, the title banners and the full backgrounds with both painted in), drawn again over the art at the output resolution so they stay sharp at any window size. Each path is SVG path data (M, L, H, V, C, S, Q, T, Z) in the sprite's texels, relative to its rect; the painted line under it, within `erase` texels (default width / 2 + 1), is filled from the art beside it first. A path ending on the sprite's left or right side runs on along an edge the screen stretches to the window's side. Traced from the art to about a fifth of a texel; the bands share one template, so a band whose trace broke on its lettering uses a sibling's paths. Drawn only while sharp text is on.
